title: Inherited kidney disease
description: Structured history and findings for an inherited kidney disease assessment.
limitations: These 42 questions across eight disease profiles are an incomplete research assessment. Three shared family-history prompts record patterns that may suggest dominant, recessive, or X-linked inheritance; they do not establish a genetic diagnosis. Unticked findings are recorded as absent for this proof of concept. Family-history prompts have zero score weight while the other present findings add candidate weights derived from LIRICAL. Scores are not calibrated disease probabilities or diagnostic criteria. A zero score does not exclude disease. A negative or unclear family history does not exclude disease, and Alport remains a broad profile without inheritance subtypes. Related findings may inflate totals, profiles have different selected features, and UMOD and MUC1 remain hard to distinguish. Timing of gout is not encoded.
associationContext: This is background context; an answer here does not establish or exclude a diagnosis.
